title: Sources: Sony is nearing a binding agreement to sell a 51% stake in its home entertainment business to Chinese rival TCL for ~$1B as soon as this month (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Sony is nearing a binding agreement to sell a 51% stake in its home entertainment business to Chinese rival TCL for ~$1B as soon as this month — Sony Group Corp. is nearing a binding agreement to sell a majority stake in its home entertainment business to Chinese rival TCL Electronics Holdings Ltd …
